Description
PAMP Suisse 1 oz Gold Bar – Romanesque Cross is a part of the Faith Series manufactured by the world’s leading swiss precious metal refiner
PAMP Suisse
in the honors of the Christian religion.
PAMP Suisse’s “Faith” range is a tremendously popular collection of bars that honor the world’s most popular religions: Christianity, Islam, Buddhism, and Hinduism. They make fantastic gifts for religious occasions and holidays.
PAMP Suisse is considered as the international precious metal platform for minting the most respected mints around the world. The Romanesque Cross is considered a symbol of the Christian religion. The Romanesque Cross PAMP Suisse 1 oz Gold Bar embodies beauty via the representation of historic religious symbols.
Romanesque Cross
is the best-known symbol for Christian hope and faith but was once served as a representation of unspeakable torture and punishment. From the 2
nd
century AD onward, the Romanesque Cross has been associated with the Christian religion in both Positive and negative terms.
This exquisitely designed PAMP Suisse 1 oz Gold Bar – Romanesque Cross is manufactured in Swizterland and contains 1 troy oz of .9999 fine gold. The gold bars are sealed inside of protective blister cards. Each of these 1 oz gold bars comes with its own individual package along with its associated certified assay card.
Design of PAMP Suisse 1 oz Gold Bar – Romanesque Cross
On the obverse of the 1 oz PAMP Suisse Romanesque Cross Gold Bar, the ornate Romanesque Cross is depicted. The 1 oz PAMP Suisse Romanesque Cross Gold Bar features a cross and a pedestal that looks as if it would have been at home in a medieval cathedral. Rays of light from the base of the cross symbolize holiness.
On the reverse of the PAMP Suisse 1 oz Gold Bar – Romanesque Cross, The Pamp Suisse logo is depicted on the top of the bar which includes the four letters PAMP in a small circle with Suisse inscribed below.  Below the PAMP Suisse logo, the weight i.e 1 ounce, and the purity of the gold bar i.e 999.9 are inscribed. At the bottom of the Gold Bar, the assayer’s stamp and the unique serial number for each bar are inscribed. The Serial numbers inscribed on the gold bars consist of one-letter, six-number code.
Main Highlights of PAMP Suisse – 1 oz Romanesque Cross Gold Bar
Contains 1 troy oz of .9999 fine gold.
Manufactured by the PAMP Suisse.
Comes with an assay certificate
Eligible for Precious Metals IRAs.
The obverse features the depiction of a cross and a pedestal that looks as if it would have been at home in the medieval cathedral
The reverse features the depiction of the PAMP logo along with the weight, purity, and assayers stamp.
Each bar is assigned a unique serial number
